lines.say: This map shows what things really cost in Vienna.
Every dot is a real price, added by people in Vienna.
Green is cheap. Red is expensive.
Pick what you want: coffee, schnitzel, kebab, pizza.
A price is missing, or wrong? Add it yourself.
lines.show: A price is missing or wrong? Add it yourself.

lines.say: Over sixteen hundred prices so far. Free, right in your browser.
lines.show: Over 1.600 prices so far. Free, right in your browser.
